The notification does not mention any upper age relaxation for reserved categories. | Candidates must have a minimum of 5 years of prior experience working with Self-Help Groups (SHG) or Panchayat Level Federations (PLF). | Candidates must be permanent residents of the block for which they are applying. | Must possess a valid two-wheeler driving license. how_to_apply: The notification does not describe an online application portal. Applications are to be submitted through offline or email mode to the address given below:
Prepare the application along with all required documents listed above.

Send the application by post to the office of the Joint Director / Project Director, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission, District Mission Management Unit (Women's Scheme), District Collector Office Campus, Kanchipuram District – 631502.
Alternatively, applications may be sent by email to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Kanchipuram TNSRLM Block Coordinator Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 14 Block Coordinator posts are vacant across five block-level units under the Kanchipuram District Mission Management Unit. The block-wise distribution is as follows: No category-wise reservation break-up (UR/SC/ST/OBC) is mentioned in the official press release for these posts.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Kanchipuram Block Coordinator Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy all of the following conditions as per the official notice: Must have passed graduation (Bachelor's degree) in any discipline along with a minimum 3-month MS Office computer training certificate, or Must hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Applications. Candidates must be within 35 years of age. The notification does not mention any upper age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates must have a minimum of 5 years of prior experience working with Self-Help Groups (SHG) or Panchayat Level Federations (PLF). Candidates must be permanent residents of the block for which they are applying. Must possess a valid two-wheeler driving license. Must submit a certificate of good conduct. Must not have been previously removed, terminated, or dismissed from service in TNSRLM, the Puduvazhvu Project, the IFAD project, or any other State Government scheme, project, or mission on disciplinary or financial grounds.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Kanchipuram Block Coordinator Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the salary or consolidated pay for the Block Coordinator post. Candidates are advised to contact the office mentioned below for salary details, as this information is not available in the press release.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Kanchipuram Block Coordinator Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official press release does not specify a detailed selection process (such as a written exam or interview). Selection will be made from among eligible applicants who meet all the criteria listed above, based on the process followed by the District Mission Management Unit. Candidates should refer to the concerned office for confirmation of the exact selection procedure.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for TNSRLM Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Completed application form Educational qualification certificates (degree certificate and MS Office / Computer Science / Computer Applications certificate, as applicable) Age proof Proof of residence in the concerned block Experience certificate showing at least 5 years of association with SHG/PLF Valid two-wheeler driving license Certificate of good conduct Any other document specified by the District Mission Management Unit

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TNSRLM Kanchipuram Block Coordinator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 Block Coordinator vacancies across five blocks: Kanchipuram, Kundrathur, Uthiramerur, Walajabad, and Thiruporur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TNSRLM Kanchipuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 07.08.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for TNSRLM Kanchipuram Block Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be within 35 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in any discipline with a 3-month MS Office certificate, or a degree in Computer Science/Computer Applications.

faq.question: Q5. Is prior experience required for the TNSRLM Block Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 5 years of experience with SHG or PLF is required.

faq.question: Q6. Can male candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification specifies that eligible women applicants from the respective block are invited to apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for TNSRLM Kanchipuram Block Coordinator?
faq.answer: The salary is not mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. How can I submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications can be sent by post to the District Mission Management Unit office in Kanchipuram or by email to [email protected].
